title: hedgehog
author: soundmary
changes: A hedgehog snuffling and sniffing, recorded indoors (the Freesound page does not name the species; most likely the European hedgehog, Erinaceus europaeus). Trimmed to 4.10–7.00 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording.
